[[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation's]] '''Universal airlock''' was a portable, collapsible [[Realspace/Legends|space]]-to-[[Starship/Legends|ship]] dock. The [[Airlock/Legends|airlock]] was made of a durable synthetic fabric stretched over a geometrically collapsible from. When collapsed, the device was half a [[Meter/Legends|meter]] in diameter, but could expand to a diameter of five minutes when deployed. One end was a bag-lock, pressurized by a pneumatic pump, and exited to space. The other end, attached to the side of the target ship, employed a multi-lock sealing ring.<ref name="PP" />
